item.title: Lughole 0.6.2
item.description:
- **Chord charts.** File > Import Chord Chart (or Chords… in the Riff Pad) opens a window where you type, paste or open a chord chart and hear it played. It reads charts the way musicians write them (bars between | lines, sections like [Verse], repeats, chords from C to F#m7b5 or C/E), lyric sheets copied from chord websites (section names, chords on their own lines, the words skipped), and ChordPro files with [chords] inside the words. It shows what it understood as you type, with any mistakes on their line. Send the chords to the Riff Pad, or add them to your song with an optional bass line and drum beat, as channels at the cursor, with a marker at each section.
- **Example chord charts.** The Examples menu in the Chord Chart window inserts a sample of each kind of chart, or saves them all as files with a README, so you can see exactly what Lughole expects.
- **Shift-click adds a channel to the selection.** Shift-click (or ⌘-click) a channel's header to add it to the selection or take it out, instead of replacing the selection.

item.title: Lughole 0.6.1
item.description:
- **Saving and exporting multi-channel audio as M4A, MP3 or Opus works again.** After adding loops, riffs or recordings as channels, those formats now save a stereo mix of what you hear (with each channel's mute, solo, volume and pan). The Save panel has a checkbox to keep every channel separate instead, where the format allows it. If macOS can't write a file, the message now says why.
- **Lock a channel.** Click the lock on a channel (or right-click it) and nothing in the app can change its audio: edits, effects, drops and deleting all leave it alone, and cutting time moves the other channels around it. Locked channels are tinted and hatched so you can see them at a glance.
- **Right-click a channel** for Mute, Solo, Solo Only This, Mute All Others, Unmute All, Lock, Duplicate, Move and Delete.
- **Select channels by clicking their header.** Click to select one, shift-click to select a run of channels, ⌘-click to add or remove one. Riff Pad samples and riffs made from a selection use only the selected channels.
- **Roll up inspector cards.** Every card on the right has a chevron to fold it away, and stays folded next time.

item.title: Lughole 0.6.0
item.description:
- **Loop Library.** A new window (⌥⌘L) full of beats, bass lines, chord parts and riffs: rock, pop, funk, hip-hop, trap, house, drum & bass, reggae, bossa nova, waltz and more, played on real drum kits and instruments. Set the tempo, key and chord progression once and every loop follows them, so they all fit together. Click to listen, then drag one onto a channel or onto "+ New channel". Drop a loop inside a selection to repeat it to fill.
- **Drum machine.** The Riff Pad has a new Drums mode: a step grid with kick, snare, hi-hats, toms, cymbals and percussion, eight drum kits, ghost notes (⌥-click) and swing. It can also play riffs on any of the 128 built-in instruments.
- **Tempo, bars and key.** Each document can have a tempo, time signature and key (click the metronome in the status bar). The ruler shows bars and beats, and drops and selections snap to the beat (hold ⌘ to place freely). Detect Tempo and Key (⌥⌘T) listens to your recording and sets them for you, so loops match your song.
- **Turn a selection into a riff.** Select part of a recording and choose Audio > Turn Selection into Riff (⇧⌘K) to get its notes in the Riff Pad, or Turn Selection into Drum Pattern (⌥⇧⌘K) to get its kick, snare and hi-hats on the drum grid, snapped to the song's tempo.
- **Record along with your song.** The Record sheet adds a metronome click, a one- or two-bar count-in, and plays the song while you record, so you can lay a part over your loops. Takes are lined up automatically.
- **Undo in the Riff Pad.** ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z now undo and redo while the Riff Pad is in front.
- **Clearer Mute and Solo.** Every channel now has big M and S buttons that light up when on, and muted channels are dimmed in the editor so you can see at a glance what you're hearing. ⌥-click S to solo just that channel.
- Muting, soloing or changing a channel's volume or pan while playing is now heard straight away, instead of on the next play.

item.title: Lughole 0.5.0
item.description:
- **Record.** Press Record (⌘R) to record from your Mac's microphone or any audio interface, straight into the document at the cursor, onto a new channel, or into a new document. A live level meter shows while you record.
- **Transcripts.** The new Text tab turns speech into text on your Mac, with a time for every word. Click a word to select it, delete words and the audio goes with them, clear out filler words in one go, and save subtitles as SRT or WebVTT, or the words as plain text.
- **Batch processing.** File > Batch Process (⇧⌘B) runs the same fixes over a whole folder of files and saves them in the format you choose, leaving the originals untouched.
- **Loudness.** Measure a file the way Spotify, Apple and broadcasters do (LUFS, true peak and loudness range) in the Info tab, and match it to their targets with Audio > Match Loudness.
- **Isolate Voice.** Apple's voice isolation as a one-click fix: keeps the voice and removes almost everything else.
- **Repair.** Remove clicks and pops, rebuild clipped peaks, tame harsh "s" sounds, and shorten long pauses.
- **Reverb, echo, tempo and pitch** in the new FX tab. Change speed without changing pitch, or pitch without changing speed.
- **Markers.** Press M to drop a marker, name it, jump between markers, and export the regions between them as separate files.

item.title: Lughole 0.4.0
item.description: - **Change a channel's instrument.** Click the guitar button on any channel. Lughole listens for the notes being played and plays them again on any of 128 built-in instruments (pianos, guitars, strings, brass, synths and more) or your Riff Pad sound. For drums, choose Follow the rhythm and every hit plays a note or chord you pick. Add the result as a new channel or replace the original.

item.title: Lughole 0.3.1
item.description: - **Add an empty channel.** Click the + New channel row at the bottom of a document, or choose Audio > Channels > Add Empty Channel (⌃⌘N), to add a silent channel alongside the others.

item.title: Lughole 0.3.0
item.description:
- **Channel headers.** Every channel now has a header beside it. Click the name to work on just that channel (⌘-click to pick several), drag it up or down to reorder, and use the icons to mute, duplicate or delete it. A channel's name and settings now stay with it when it moves.
- **Samples in the Riff Pad.** Select part of any recording and choose Use Selection as Riff Pad Sample (⌥⌘K). It joins the Riff Pad's sound list and plays across the keyboard from its original pitch.
- The version number is shown in the status bar.

item.title: Lughole 0.2.0
item.description:
- **Separate instruments.** The new Stems tab splits a song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and everything else, right on your Mac. Open them as channels you can mute, solo and balance, as separate files, or keep only the parts you want (untick Vocals for a karaoke version).
- **Riff Pad.** A keyboard synth in its own window (⌘K). Play or click in a short riff, then drag it onto a channel to mix it in, or onto the new "+ New channel" row to add it as a channel of its own.
- Fixed a crash when saving a newly generated document, and one when adding a channel.

item.title: Lughole 0.1.0
item.description: - First release: a native audio editor for macOS. Open almost any audio (and the sound from video), fix voices with one click, edit channels, generate tones, and save to WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC, AAC, Apple Lossless, MP3, Opus or Ogg.
